title: Robyn Is Here
producers: Ulf Lindström|Johan Ekhé|Max Martin|Denniz Pop|Christian Falk|Anders Bagge|Harry Sommerdahl
notes: Hook-driven Swedish dance-pop combines contemporary R&B cadences, bright melodies and polished programmed rhythms.

title: My Truth
producers: Ulf Lindström|Johan Ekhé|Billy Mann|Kenneth Fambro|Cherno Jah|Masters at Work|Christian Falk|Tom Hofwander
notes: More organic R&B and soul arrangements frame personal writing, introspection and understated club textures.

title: Don't Stop the Music
notes: Brisk R&B-inflected hooks and electronic pop alternate with ballads and candid emotional writing.
